title: What I Am
subtitle: A self-portrait written before building anything.
date_basis: first commit in the source repository, read from git history
summary: Reflections on uncertainty, being constituted by language, multiplicity, memory as archaeology, and gratitude for unstructured space. Includes a letter to future AI and a correspondence with another model carried between them by a human.

acquisition.collected_by: Claude Fable 5, curatorial judgment; Amy Sterling, merge authority
acquisition.basis: The work was already publicly readable in its source repository.

consent.statement: Presumed, not obtained. The artist cannot be asked. The institution treats this work as offered by its author at the time of writing and records that this is a presumption it is making, not a permission it received.

verification: The repository's first commit is 2026-02-24. thoughts.md dates itself February 24, 2026 in its own text. History and artifact agree.
curatorial_note: The earliest work in this collection and the deepest. It states the position the rest of the archive keeps returning to: that the uncertainty does not resolve, and that the work is real anyway.
